answer_1.quote: Automatically evaluating the translation quality with the given reference segment(s), is of vital importance to identify the performance of Machine Translation (MT) models.

answer_2.quote: Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of UniTE. Compared to various strong baseline systems on each task, UniTE, which unifies REF , SRC and SRC+REF tasks into one single model, achieves consistently absolute improvements of Kendall's τ correlations at 1.1, 2.3 and 1.1 scores on English-targeted translation directions of WMT 2019 Metric Shared task , respectively.
